title: Civil Services Qulaification for Appointment as High Court Judge Act 1965

sections.shortTitle: Civil Services Qulaification for Appointment as High Court Judge Act 1965
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE CIVIL SERVICES (QUALIFICATION FOR APPOINTMENT AS HIGH COURT JUDGE)
ACT, 1965
THE CIVIL SERVICES
(QUALIFICATION FOR APPOINTMENT AS HIGH COURT JUDGE) ACT, 1965
ACT No. XXI of
1965
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965,
Ext., p. 1348.)
[3rd December,
1965]
An Act to
prescribe the Civil Service of Pakistan to be a civil service for the purposes
of paragraph (b) of clause (2) of Article 92 of the Constitution.
1. Short title and
commencement------(1) This Act may be called the Civil Services (Qualifi cation
for Appointment as High Court Judge) Act, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
